description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: TokenBucket.kt's allow always returns true. Implement it properly: the constructor takes (capacity: Double, refillRate: Double) - refillRate tokens are added per second, capped at capacity tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(now: Double): Boolean refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 token and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time.
name: add_kotlin_token_bucket_limiter
